guide_q: what is an outpoint and what does a full node obtain from the output it points at?
note: guide_q / agent / root: the questions the page test asks the guide and one agent. The outpoint agent covers six concepts (the outpoint, the previous transaction's identifier, the output index, the rule against double spending, conflicting transactions and the UTXO database), every one with an executed example, and it is not the largest agent (the malleability problems, the segregated witness and the coinbase groups each cover five or six too, and the structure of the branches gives several agents of that size). The switches say what the chapter has: corpus_kinds lists every kind of passage the agents search since page build 4.14.0 (book, chapter, course, page, research, standard); course_outcomes is true because the course-level ontologies exist and LO-6 is the outcome this chapter serves; code_layers is true because every one of the 85 worked examples is a Python expression the page executes (template 9.36.0 feeds n.io.code to the syntax and behaviour extractor). The question bank of chapter 6 is complete (an item for every concept, two for every concept with a worked example, one of them an Apply program), so bank_complete is not set to false.
